source.title: Fast Functional Lists, Hash-Lists, Deques and Variable Length Arrays
source.author: Phil Bagwell
source.sections: §2.1 VList concept; §2.3 extending a VList; §2.5 growth factor used in the list benchmark
source.discovery_scope: RosettaGit title page used only to identify the VList topic; no task prose, examples, tests, submissions, or code used.

operation_tags.0: cons(value): (0,latest_root,value); creates a new root with value at the head
operation_tags.1: cdr(root): (1,root,-1); creates a root at the old list's second element; empty cdr is invalid

contract.growth_factor: 2; block capacities along the build chain are 1,2,4,8,16,32
contract.persistence: Root 0 is empty. Cons operations form a linear chain and must target the latest root. Each earlier root remains queryable; cdr creates another saved root. All cons operations precede every cdr/nth/length operation, so no build writes occur after query phase begins.
contract.block_model: Each block records its capacity, monotonically increasing LastUsed offset, and a previous (block,offset) root. A cons on the latest root extends the unused slot while it fits; when full it allocates a block twice as large, linked to the prior root. cdr decrements the offset or follows the previous root at offset zero.
contract.output: One little-endian signed i64 per operation: new root ID for cons/cdr, element for nth, or length for length.
contract.malformed: Malformed frame, invalid root/tag/sentinel/value/index, empty cdr, non-latest cons, or cons after query phase returns -1 before output-capacity handling.
contract.output_error: Valid null output or capacity below 8*Q returns -2 and writes no bytes.

workspace.meaning: Fixed 63-i64 VList data area, six block descriptors, 49 saved root pairs, 48 staged i64 results, parser locals, and alignment; input storage and output storage are excluded.

complexity.primary_time: O(Q log N) for VList block-chain length and index/tail traversals plus O(N) build work; N<=32, Q<=48.
complexity.primary_auxiliary_space: O(N+Q): at most 63 i64 data slots, six block descriptors, 49 root pairs, and 48 result words.
complexity.independent_reference_time: O(Q*N) from copying tuple versions on cons/cdr and direct tuple length/index operations, with N<=32 and Q<=48.
complexity.independent_reference_auxiliary_space: O(Q*N) for retained immutable tuple versions, bounded by 49 roots of at most 32 elements.
